title: Specimen stand, upright, single foramen
description:
A stand for displaying one specimen with its nerve hole facing outward.

The prongs are kept to a minimum. The pads adjust.
condition: Functional. Not tested with any specimen other than the one it was made for.

title: Portable table, backpack-mounted
description:
A surface that extends from a backpack for use where a lap would otherwise be used.

The weight of the pack on the ground keeps the surface level.
condition: Requires a loaded pack. A full water bottle is an acceptable ballast.

title: Crocheted "Garment"
description: What seems to be an attempt to create a garment crocheted out of various yarns. Possibly unfinished.
